stem.en: A common talcum powder contains 4 % m/m zinc oxide, which acts as an antiseptic. How many grams of zinc oxide are in 300 g of the talcum powder?

explanation.en: 4 % m/m means 4 g of zinc oxide in every 100 g of powder. 300 g is three times 100 g, so it holds 3 × 4 g = 12 g. A percentage stays the same for any amount of powder, so you only need to scale up.

hints.en: How many grams of zinc oxide are in 100 g of the powder?
How many times does 100 g fit into 300 g?
